title: 2023年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
paperTitle: 2023年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
prompt: Suppose the student union of your university is organizing an online discussion on college students doing community service. You are to write an essay on its benefits and the service you can provide to the community. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: These days, more and more college students are getting involved in community service. In my view, this is a meaningful practice that benefits both the community and ourselves. Community service brings benefits to both society and the people who offer it. On the one hand, it warms our neighborhood: by visiting lonely elderly people or helping local children with their studies, we deliver real care to those in need. On the other hand, it shapes us as individuals, since serving others trains our communication skills and sense of responsibility. As for me, the service I can provide is teaching English. Being good at this subject, I plan to offer free English lessons to children in my community every weekend, so that they can enjoy learning and grow with confidence. In short, doing community service is well worth our effort, as it helps others and improves ourselves at the same time. I sincerely hope that more of us will step out and act.
keyPoints: 一句引题＋一句表态。落实首段蓝图：第一句 These days, more and more college students are getting involved in community service 引出话题；第二句 In my view, this is a meaningful practice that benefits both the community and ourselves 直接亮立场并预告『利人利 己』两条线，对应 its benefits。

主题句＋两层好处＋落地服务。用主题句 Community service brings benefits to both society and the people who offer it 统起本段，再以 On the one hand / On the other hand 分出惠 及他人与提升自己两层（各配老人、孩子的小场景），随后用 As for me 转到 the service you can provide to the community，落到每周末免费教孩子英语这件具体可行的事。
重申＋号召闭环。用 In short 重申『利人利己』立场，再用 I sincerely hope that more of us will step out and act 发出号召，呼应学生会的 online discussion，结构收口。
